guides.title: 重佈線層微影與電鍍：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Redistribution-layer lithography and plating: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 種子層、電鍍及去種子層共同決定線路。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Seed, plating and seed removal jointly define routing. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。圖中為 Quilt Packaging 焊料互連，不是 RDL 金屬線的截面。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：種子層、電鍍及去種子層共同決定線路。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以線寬、厚度及隔離電阻形成三維驗收。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. This shows Quilt Packaging solder interconnects, not an RDL metal-line cross-section. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Seed, plating and seed removal jointly define routing. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Accept against width, thickness and isolation resistance. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以線寬、厚度及隔離電阻形成三維驗收」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Accept against width, thickness and isolation resistance, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

sources.title: AIM Photonics: Test, Assembly and Packaging

guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 重佈線層微影與電鍍：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Redistribution-layer lithography and plating: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「互連功能分層」建立判讀邊界。電源與訊號線有不同寬度、阻抗和電流需求。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Interconnect function layers to define the interpretation boundary. Power and signal traces need different widths, impedances and currents. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜互連功能分層：標每層網路及回流面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜電鍍線形：量線頂、底及彎角截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜可靠度與設計回饋：建立失效位置對版圖規則的對照。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Interconnect function layers: Mark networks and return planes per layer. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Plated profile: Measure top, bottom and bend sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Reliability and design feedback: Map failures back to layout rules. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「電鍍線形」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「可靠度與設計回饋」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Plated profile: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Reliability and design feedback to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：最小線寬可用於所有電源線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：電鍍總量可直接推得最小線截面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Using minimum width for all power traces. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Inferring minimum cross-section from total plated mass. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

related.title: 銅柱微凸塊製作
related.why: 共用圖形電鍍、種子與電流分配
related.whyEn: Shares patterned plating, seed and current distribution
related.transfer: 共用圖形電鍍、種子與電流分配
related.transferEn: Shares patterned plating, seed and current distribution
related.difference: RDL 關心橫向細線及彎折，銅柱關心高寬與共面性
related.differenceEn: RDL emphasizes thin lateral traces/bends; pillars emphasize aspect and coplanarity
practice: 以「互連功能分層」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「電源與訊號線有不同寬度、阻抗和電流需求。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「標每層網路及回流面。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use interconnect function layers to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Power and signal traces need different widths, impedances and currents.
Using "Mark networks and return planes per layer.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.
